description: As a retired command chief master sergeant of the Maine Air National Guard, I understand firsthand the critical role infrastructure plays in readiness and national security. That’s why I want to thank Sen. Susan Collins for her steadfast leadership in securing $50 million for a new hangar at the 101st Air Refueling Wing in Bangor. Read the […]
